3.2.0.headline: Your sleep confirm window moved.
3.2.0.detail: It used to be a time you set. It now opens 30 minutes after you press Wake and stays open for 30 minutes, and your night and wake windows are untouched. A confirm you place yourself can be placed at an hour you are already up, which proves nothing. It starts tomorrow: tonight is judged by the windows you already had.

3.2.0.headline: Grace is now yours to spend.
3.2.0.detail: Two a month for each activity you track, in one pool, used on whichever streak you choose after it breaks. It still only holds a streak, so fines and standing are untouched as they always were. Settings shows how many you have left.

3.2.0.headline: A shared photograph belongs to the group it was sent to.
3.2.0.detail: Sharing an activity with a new group shares what you do from now on. Photographs taken before that stay where they were. Stopping sharing, or leaving, takes yours out of that group for good.
